title: Planning records the kb line that answers each benchmark candidate question, not only the pack's verdict
goal: A sprint plan that lists benchmark question candidates by pack verdict (split, weak, good) also records the kb line that answers each one's present part: at SP-j2jn5ue4 the planned sc_partial candidates (new Teams client, Ansible win_updates, SQL Server backup to URL) had no answering kb line, so the worker replaced them with compound questions whose route may flip on small rewording.
